Visitor removes all horizontal rules

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

visitor <- list(
  visit_horizontal_rule = function(ctx) {
    "skip"
  }
)

result <- convert(html = "<p>Part 1</p><hr><p>Part 2</p><hr><p>Part 3</p>", options = list(visitor = visitor))
print(result)
```
